name: HKBU
notes:
Battle-test round for the 2026-27 HK target list (entry year 2027). HKBU's TPG programme index is server-rendered and the deterministic tier handles it with no registry entry: classify() scores inline_degree 49 / merged_columns 49 (tie resolved to inline_degree) and extract_inline_degree yields exactly 49 programmes with 49 unique detail URLs; the live crawl (--all, default page type) imported 49/49 with full coverage of zh name, faculty, tuition, study options and deadlines and 48/49 requirements.

Defects this round surfaced and fixed before the full run: _university_slug took the leftmost host label (ar.hkbu.edu.hk -> 'ar'; gs.cuhk/gs.hsu/gs.hksyu collided on 'gs'); _init_db swallowed migration failures so a crawl against a half-migrated database reported '0 programs imported' as if the university had no programmes; DATABASE_URL set in the shell was clobbered by .env (override=True); and the 'auto' page type never resolved for a server-fetched index, so the index page was fed to the LLM as a detail page. 'auto' was retired: the caller states index or detail (default index).

Known cost issue, not fixed this round: every HKBU detail page converts to ~117k chars of markdown of which ~90% is the site's mega-menu link list; the real programme content (~5.5k chars) lands in chunk 8 of 8, so 7 of the 8 extraction calls per programme parse navigation. The 49-programme run took 95 minutes and 3.8M tokens (~$2.27 on deepseek-v4-flash). detail.md here is the MA in Communication page and reproduces that shape (detail markdown_chars ~118k).
